purpose: Support the source-proven stock ordinary Calc LOAD dependency while preserving the same Office executable, fresh profile, locale, font view and native metric method.

exact_stock_request.expected_topology_source_only: Office --glibc posix_spawn/clone3 vfork--> dash --dash vforkexec/vfork--> paperconf; distinct child PIDs, not a single allowed fork
exact_stock_request.once_caveat: PaperInfo caches only a successfully parsed paper or successful LC_PAPER newlocale. If both fail, another default-paper call may spawn again; the proposed once policy refuses that event rather than assuming readiness.

immutable_semantics: No changes to ooSetupSystemLocale, LANG, LC_ALL, LC_PAPER, PAPERSIZE, PATH, HOME/XDG, font inputs, profile data or Office binary.
No new /etc/paperspecs or /etc/papersize bind, fake paperconf, command wrapper, LD_PRELOAD, forced return, inferior write or skipped popen.
Keep /etc as the same masked tmpfs with existing named binds; retain the original baseline font view.
The helper result remains consumed only by stock LO fgets/pclose and fallback code. An observer must not read from the pipe and steal output.
Original IDLE/METRIC/CLOSED native phase schema and all ten raw digit/thread/font/device/return-site guards remain unchanged.

phase_gate.new_small_marker_needed: An atomic dependency-window marker, nonce/operation-bound, opened immediately before the existing inner loadComponentFromURL call and closed in its finally block. No URL/document content in marker.
phase_gate.existing_marker_insufficient: Current native phase.json says IDLE during LOAD; current inner result stage LOAD is memory-only until terminal result. Generic IDLE cannot authorize a child.
open_conditions: known exact Office inferior/PID/birth and direct GDB parent
records empty and active metric slot absent
source/config/component pins and boundary metadata unchanged
phase_gate.close_conditions: Every LOAD return/exception closes the window. Helper custody must be closed before MODEL_LOADED envelope is released and before the first METRIC transition.

state_machine.rule: All existing fork/vfork/exec catchpoints refuse. A LOAD marker alone is insufficient.

At the exact pinned libc popen entry, require exact pinned LO PaperInfo caller/callsite and same parent thread; compare only bounded NUL-terminated known command/mode constants. Log equality booleans, never arbitrary argument values. Arm a single pending spawn. Symbols alone are insufficient: PC-to-pinned-image/callsite binding is required.

Require pending popen state, exact parent PID/birth/inferior/thread and direct numeric child relation; record child PID/birth once. Require the exact expected glibc spawn route and zero earlier child births.

Before any shell user code, bind that same child to the pinned /bin/sh symlink topology and /usr/bin/dash bytes; compare a bounded expected static argv only. Keep traced custody; no detach. Any other executable or command refuses.

Permit only the exact admitted shell child at its pinned evalcommand/vforkexec callsite to create one direct numeric child. Record second PID/birth and parent relation. No generic shell fork permission.

Bind second child to /usr/bin/paperconf exact bytes and argv [paperconf] before user code. Confirm loader/libc/libpaper dependencies from the actual child mapping against pinned canonical files and the reviewed source basis. No other image or child birth.

Observe both exact child exits, stock wait/pclose completion, original parent identity and both child absences/reaping. Under the source-predicted unchanged masked config, expect paperconf3 then shell3, no helper stdout; do not manufacture or force that result. Nonmatching status/output/path facts refuse or require a separately reviewed contract.

Exactly the original Office process remains, helper state cannot reopen, original single-inferior identity rule holds again before metric work. Retain child identities and statuses as dependency evidence, separate from actual_M.

custody_and_resources.same_containment: Both children inherit the existing no-network namespace and whole-owned-unit/cgroup limits; no new network, mount, unit or service permissions.
custody_and_resources.filesystem: Dependencies stay read-only under existing host/toolchain mounts. Only expected stdout pipe and stderr /dev/null writes; reject writable user/source handles, unapproved inherited FDs or sockets. Do not dump arbitrary FD contents or paths.
custody_and_resources.deadline: All stages consume the existing absolute LOAD deadline and outer operation deadline, whichever expires first. No new/reset clocks or exemptions; exact subdeadline may be shorter only after a measured isolated helper fixture and explicit plan binding.
custody_and_resources.CPU_memory_PIDs: Existing whole-tree CPU/memory/PID accounting includes both descendants. No increased limits are supplied by this proposal.
custody_and_resources.debugger: Keep catchpoints enabled for all processes and detach-on-fork off. Explicitly handle additional inferior/new_objfile/exit events without rebinding the original Office identity, trace exit_code or metric breakpoints to a helper. Multi-inferior scheduling/vfork suspension must be tested with actual installed GDB before Office.
custody_and_resources.failure_cleanup: Any unexpected event, identity drift, extra spawn/exec, signal, timeout or unknown exit keeps REFUSED and invokes original exact whole-owned-tree cleanup. Include both admitted PID/births; verify cgroup empty. Killing only the original Office inferior is insufficient; no PID-name/global kill.

nearest_consumers_requiring_coherent_del: inner_client exact config schema/paths plus marker creation/finally close
native observer config validation, process boundary callback, explicit child state, install/new_objfile/exit dispatch and finally cleanup
outer namespace_entry allowed work files, observer config/basis, trace/loaded-envelope checks and dependency closure before MODEL_LOADED release
outer_runner exact source/config/dependency pins, child custody evidence and unchanged whole-tree resource/retirement checks
required_tests_before_any_office_operati: Reuse Root-accepted unchanged actual helper topology/loader/status/scheduling evidence from the just-closed nonOffice fixture. New policy bytes still require meaningful enforcement/negative-control tests; do not repeat the same helper effect merely to reconfirm unchanged source facts.
Review one coherent source delta on frozen bytes and nearest consumers; show original metric method/ten raw guards and single-parent identity remain identical outside the finite helper state.

Run a tiny actual installed-GDB fixture with this exact glibc popen constant, pinned dash and paperconf in the same masked environment; no Office, document, model, render or send. Verify two descendants, exact exec argv/images, mappings, statuses, vfork scheduling and complete cleanup.

Verify actual namespace absence of both system and XDG paperspecs/papersize and PAPERSIZE; current metadata is source/host evidence only. Verify actual helper library resolution, loader/libc/libpaper pins and FD custody without dumping content.

Negative controls: wrong command/mode/caller/module/callsite, no/wrong/stale LOAD marker, wrong nonce, outside LOAD/METRIC attempt, wrong parent/PID birth, wrong shell/helper hash or argv, extra spawn/exec, unexpected nested child, changed PATH/dependency, signal, child hang and deadline. Each must stop before unreviewed user code and leave the owned tree empty.

Prove no metric records/helper breakpoints or exit status can be attributed to helper inferiors, that children are absent before metric phase, and that the unchanged valid metric ABI fixture still passes.

Only after Root accepts frozen code and fixture evidence may a distinct finite current-instance operation be considered. It remains a new source/runtime fact and cannot replay the closed R2/R3 effects or establish retained historical producer equivalence.
why_no_partial_patch: The current hook requires a single inferior globally, has a single process exit_code, and new_objfile install dispatch assumes that identity. Merely suppressing one catchpoint would both miss dash nested vfork and corrupt/lose custody. This finite task provides the exact minimal contract rather than an unsafe untested GDB mutation.
